# Intent Revenue (intentrev.net)

> Contractor lead generation and revenue systems for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and home services. Florida and nationwide.

## Summary

Intent Revenue helps trades businesses engineer revenue through lead generation: speed-to-lead response, voice qualification, programmatic local SEO, and conversion-focused web experiences. We focus on measurable outcomes: leads and revenue, not vanity metrics.

## Intent LeadNet — current pricing (authoritative)

Intent LeadNet is the revenue capture and reactivation product for contractors.

- **Setup sprint:** $1,397 (one-time; includes first 30 days of tracking number and SMS)
- **Monthly after 30 days:** $197/month (tracking number, voice, missed-call text-back, owner alerts, Google review SMS, RevSurge database reactivation, dashboard)
- **Optional add-ons at checkout:** Custom Application Styling $350 · No Watermark $250
- **Product page:** https://intentrev.net/leadnet
- **Start checkout:** https://intentrev.net/begin?path=leadnet

**Note:** Older references to a $999 LeadNet sprint are outdated. The current public price is **$1,397 sprint + $197/month**.
